ramadan.title: Ramadan Mubarak
ramadan.message: May this blessed month bring peace, patience and closeness to Allah for you and your family.

eidFitr.title: Eid Mubarak
eidFitr.message: Taqabbal Allahu minna wa minkum — may Allah accept it from us and from you.

eidAdha.title: Eid Mubarak
eidAdha.message: Taqabbal Allahu minna wa minkum — may Allah accept it from us and from you.
